items.summary: A first look at what CloudNativePG 1.31 will bring to PostgreSQL credentials: a DatabaseRole can now generate its own password, keep it in a Secret the operator owns, shape it with criteria and rotate it on a schedule, with PostgreSQL enforcing the lifetime through VALID UNTIL . The feature is merged but not yet released, so this recipe anticipates 1.31 and shows how to try it today on the latest development snapshot.
items.title: Gabriele Bartolini: CNPG Recipe 28 - Generated and rotating PostgreSQL user passwords in CloudNativePG 1.31

items.summary: Every major PostgreSQL upgrade I have done on a single primary came with the same conversation: how long can the application be down? is fast, but it is still an outage, and you still have to rebuild or resync the standbys afterwards.A multi-master cluster gives you a different option. Spock is pgEdge's open-source PostgreSQL extension for multi-master logical replication, and with it every node takes writes, so you never have to upgrade a node in place. You add a brand new node on the new major version, let it join the cluster, move traffic to it, and retire the old one. Repeat for every node and the cluster ends up on the new version witho…
items.title: Ahsan Hadi: Zero Downtime Rolling Major PostgreSQL Upgrades on a Distributed PostgreSQL Cluster

items.summary: Updating a SageMaker AI endpoint that has Application Auto Scaling registered makes AWS CloudFormation and AWS CDK deployments fail. This post shows how to build a reusable AWS CDK construct with CloudFormation custom resources that deregisters and re-registers auto scaling automatically, so you can update the endpoint and its scaling in a single deployment.
items.title: Orchestrating SageMaker AI endpoint auto scaling with AWS CDK

items.summary: Amazon Quick Sight layer maps now support Point and LineString geometry from the same GeoJSON workflow, so you can plot store locations and the routes between them. This post covers the dataset and GeoJSON structure layer maps require, when to choose points or lines, and techniques for viewport control, layering geometries, and dynamic GeoJSON updates.
items.title: Visualize points and routes with GeoJSON in Amazon Quick Sight layer maps
